messages:
Ava Ruiz: Hi team 2 starting onboarding question: I want to add my partner to dental/medical. The enrollment UI only shows spouse/child. Is domestic partner supported and what docs do you need? Also worried about timing since my first paycheck posted already.

Maya (People Ops): Welcome, Ava! Yes, domestic partners are eligible. We need a signed domestic partner affidavit + one proof of shared residence (lease, bank stmt, utility) within the last 90 days. I can DM the PDF. Send everything to benefits@redwood.com.

Nikhil (Benefits): FYI: include the desired effective date in the email. If docs come in within 30 days we usually request retro to your start date. Carriers decide on retro premiums; if approved we'll work with payroll on proration.

Ava Ruiz: Thanks. If carrier approves retro, will payroll take a single large deduction or can it be spread out? My rent timeline is tight this month.

Maya (People Ops): Tagging @PayrollBot to clarify catch-up behavior.

PayrollBot: PayrollBot: Standard: deductions begin after enrollment processes. For retro coverage we calculate a prorated catch-up deduction. We can split catch-up across multiple pay periods on request (usually across next 2-3 pays) to ease burden. If carrier bills us directly for retro premiums, Benefits coordinates reimbursements.

Nikhil (Benefits): Also note HSA elections must be set in Workday within 30 days to contribute. If you want retro HSA contributions, mention it in the benefits email and we'll coordinate prorated contribution catch-up with payroll.

Ava Ruiz: My partner is on COBRA through 2024-07-05. Should I enroll now or wait until COBRA ends?

Nikhil (Benefits): Enroll now with your preferred effective date. After new coverage is active, attach COBRA paperwork in an email with subject "COBRA" and we'll notify the COBRA admin to stop billing. Timely docs usually avoid overlap; if overlap happens we'll help with refunds.

Ava Ruiz: Uploaded affidavit + joint bank stmt and added "RETRO + COBRA" to the subject. Thanks for the guidance.

Maya (People Ops): Got it. We'll triage the upload. If payroll needs to perform catch-up deductions we'll DM you before applying any lump sums. Ping here if you don't hear back in 48 hours.

Ava Ruiz: Appreciate it, thank you!
